FIELDS.NAME: Shear Elegance Beauty Salon
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Shear Elegance Beauty Salon, we specialize in providing a wide range of hair and beauty services, operating exclusively in a commercial space to ensure compliance and safety. Our services include hair cutting, styling, dyeing, conditioning, and shampooing, all performed by our licensed and certified staff. We strictly adhere to health, safety, and sanitation regulations, maintaining up-to-date professional liability insurance to manage potential claims effectively. Additionally, we utilize professional-grade products and equipment to minimize risks, and we have implemented robust sanitation protocols. Our operational focus is centered on creating a welcoming and safe environment for clients, where they can receive quality services without the risk associated with prohibited or invasive procedures.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that it has attached forms LS-76 and LS-76A, while ensuring that all services provided are within coverage limitations. Additionally, all staff performing services are appropriately licensed and certified per state and local regulations, and the salon does not offer any medical or invasive cosmetic procedures.
